title: Daily Briefing
plan:
Stream the body in via update_document with insert ops, one block at a time. Recommended structure:

1. replace the header block: set title to today's human date (e.g. "Tuesday, April 7") and subtitle to a short greeting using the user's name.
2. insert a kpis block with 3 metrics: Meetings (count), Unread Emails (count), Weather (city + temp).
3. insert a text block starting with "## Today's Schedule" listing meetings with times, titles, and one-line context.
4. insert a callout variant="info" title="Top Priorities" with 2–4 prioritized bullets.
5. insert a text block starting with "## Email Highlights" summarizing 3–5 emails that actually matter today.
6. insert a text block starting with "## Follow-ups Due" listing todos due today or overdue.
7. insert a footer block.

Gather data in parallel before inserting (check calendar, memory for priorities, unread email summaries). Never write literal "{{PLACEHOLDER}}" text. Skip any block you don't have real content for.
